title: Design note design/daw-set.md: the set format and the Apricity-to-set mapping table
description:
## Intent

Read the reference sets and write down the format, so later tasks never guess.

## Steps

- Gunzip each reference set and diff it against `empty.als` to isolate what each feature adds.
- Write `design/daw-set.md` with: skeleton; id and pointee rules; audio clip fields (position, loop, warp markers, warp mode values, transpose, detune, gain units and range, reverse); sample references (relative/absolute, collected layout, what happens with clashing file names); tempo, time signature, loop brace, locators, scale; group/return/send/volume/pan units and ranges; sidechain routing; every stock device's parameters with units and ranges; automation envelope structure.
- Add a first mapping table Apricity → set, one row per `Timeline` field used (`crates/apricity-score/src/compile.rs`: `Timeline`, `Event`, `TrackInfo`, `BusInfo`, `ChordSpan`, `Lane`, `MasterSpec`).
- Keep `design/vocabulary.md` in step if the note introduces a word.

## Verification

Reviewer reads `design/daw-set.md` against a gunzipped reference set (`gunzip -c crates/apricity-daw/tests/fixtures/reference/clip.als | less`); every row of the mapping table names the XML element it writes.

## Release

`docs(<this task's id>): design note for the DAW set format`. Not breaking.

## Depends on

The reference sets task in this epic.
